newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan raises Bethlehem Steel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan raises Bethlehem Steel.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan steel analyst Mike Gambardella said he raised his estimate on Bethlehem Steel Corp's 1997 earnings to $0.90 per share from $0.55 per share.
-- Gambardella said he raised his estimate because of the company's improved first quarter results. The company posted earnings of $0.25 per share, beating Wall Street's consensus of $0.12.
-- Gambardella said Bethlehem Steel showed improved product mix and relatively flat unit costs in the quarter.
